headline: Castillo converts from sustained final-third pressure and set-piece volume
explanation: Riverside Athletic scored through Castillo at 25' after a period where they dominated activity in and around the final third (3 final-third passes, 5 corners) and produced a measured chance (team xG 0.26). Northgate United had more overall shot threat and higher cumulative xG (0.47) in the same window, but Riverside’s concentrated possession and set-piece volume created the specific opportunity that was finished.
tactical_pattern: Sustained final-third possession and set-piece overload leading to a low-xG but high-probability scoring opportunity
